CompanionUpgrade.installHint: Bind one acquired upgrade to one synchronized automaton. Installation is free; each activation pays its Intellect cost with Edge.
CompanionUpgrade.activationHint: Confirm that this use is physically possible. Armor and turret replace the automaton's current physical form and use its action. Armor within immediate distance forms around you; otherwise it must be equipped later. Cypher capacity lasts one day. The level 5 force field and Beast Eyes end on your next ten-minute or longer recovery; armor ends on a one-hour or longer recovery. Beast Eyes uses your action and the declared companion from Companion circumstances. Turret operators must declare their grip before attacking.
CompanionUpgrade.fieldTargets: Selected creatures within immediate range of the field (automaton included automatically)
CompanionUpgrade.immediate: All selected field recipients are within immediate range; wearer is within immediate range for automatic armor donning
CompanionUpgrade.withinRange: Sensory link remains within 1 mile (1.6 km)
CompanionUpgrade.visionToken: Actual beast token for native sight
CompanionUpgrade.carrying: The flying automaton is carrying you
CompanionUpgrade.carryingFlight: Flight carrying you: up to 20 ft (6 m) per round
CompanionUpgrade.longFlight: Flight: up to long distance as normal movement
CompanionUpgrade.unavailable: Upgrade unavailable: check GM authority, acquired source, synchronized companion, permissions, costs, declared range, action timing and unfinished activations.
CompanionUpgrade.pendingShot: Interrupted turret shot: GM review required before replaying any consequences.
CompanionUpgrade.fireHint: The automaton must be set to independent action. One hindered attack per round, Last action, very long range, 7 damage. Against NPCs, adjudicate the hindered hit. A pending shot after a partial failure requires GM review and cannot replay automatically.
CompanionUpgrade.inRange: Target is within very long range
CompanionUpgrade.hitConfirmed: GM confirms the hindered attack hits the NPC
CompanionUpgrade.roundId: Narrative round ID when outside combat (letters, digits, _ or -)
CompanionUpgrade.pcDamageHint: Declare the wound corresponding to the numeric weapon against this PC; this is an explicit GM ruling. The PC makes a Dodge defense; a macro can instead provide a Pool profile or other defense options.
